data.title: Shinsei Galverse
data.synopsis:
Long ago, harmony across the galaxy was maintained by a sacred star known as the Mother Planet. But that peace was shattered when the Mother mysteriously exploded and vanished without a trace.

In the aftermath, the galaxy plunged into chaos and conflict. Yet from the scattered remnants of the Mother Planet, new beings were born—sentient fragments known as the Galverse.

Now, these Galverse girls, each imbued with extraordinary powers and an unstoppable gal spirit, rise to confront the evil organization "Space End Society." As they battle across the stars, they begin to uncover the truth behind the galaxy's collapse—and the fate of the Mother Planet itself.

(Source: MAL News)

data.title: Ling Long 2nd Season
data.synopsis:
In this thrilling continuation, former Wilderness Hunter Commander Marc has transformed into a blood-stained monster who destroys lighthouses. Guided by the enigmatic Bai Yuekui, he embarks on a new mission. The arrival of survivors on the ground reveals that the lighthouse isn't humanity's final refuge. Facing adversity, they harness their innate abilities to combat the Mana ecosystem. Bai Yuekui's past intricately links to Mark's origins and the apocalypse's truth.

Meanwhile, the colossal brain on the lighthouse awakens, the old shadows linger, and a new crisis emerges. As unprecedented disasters loom, where will the two human factions ultimately head?

(Source: Bilibili YouTube Channel)

data.title_english: Dragon Heart: Adventures Beyond This World
data.title_japanese: ドラゴン・ハート―霊界探訪記―
title_synonyms: Dragon Heart: An Exploration of the Spirit World
data.synopsis:
Ryusuke is a junior high school student living in Tokyo. During his summer vacation, he visits Tokushima and reunites with his teenage cousin, Tomomi. Ryusuke and Tomomi go outing to the Anabuki River where they get swept away by the rushing current.

As they sink to the bottom of the river, a dragon appears, rescues them, and takes them to a mysterious old man. The old man tells Ryusuke and Tomomi that they are already dead, but that he can send them back to life if they explore the spirit world and find their mission in life. Although perplexed with the situation, Ryusuke and Tomomi decide to begin their journey to the spirit world. First, they arrive in a gloomy town that looks like it’s from the 1960’s. Soon after, they are assailed by terrible things one after another. They see fear-ridden rogues killing one another and doctors mutilating patients. People die and rise. They get killed and rise again. Ryusuke and Tomomi realize that they are in hell. But their journey doesn’t end there. The adventure beyond this world continues into the unknown. Will they be able to find their mission in life?

(Source: dragonheart-movie.com)

data.title: Jun You Yun II
data.synopsis:
Xie Kanhua was about to be executed in the Shanglin Celestial Palace. When Su Baiyi was rescuing him, the Shanglin Celestial Palace disintegrated, and Su Baiyi was taken away by Su Jian, the Demon Lord who had voluntarily confined himself in the secluded prison for twenty years. Then the Hero Conference of Xuanwei Town is held again, Bai Jile lures Divine Official Xue, the second-best martial artist in the world to participate, plunging the martial arts world into chaos. In order to save the injured Nangong Xi'er, Su Baiyi went to the North Kunlun with Su Jian to pay a visit to Su Suomo, the ancestor of the Su family, while Yuling and Feng Zuojun respectively headed to Qingcheng Mountain and the Demon Town to learn martial arts. Under the latent tension, the Yingzhou Immortal Island reappeared. The invaders from the island issued a provocation to the martial artists, saying that those who submit will prosper, while those who resist will perish...

(Source: Bilibili)

data.title: Wo de Shixiong Tai Qiang Le
data.title_english: My Senior Brother is Too Strong
data.synopsis:
Due to the cultivator Lu Shaoqing accidentally obtained the immortal treasure "Spring and Autumn Ring", he was listed as a world-destroying demon by the righteous immortal alliance and was hunted to death. He accidentally traveled through time and space back to a thousand years ago and shared a body with the enemy who killed him. In order to survive, Lu Shaoqing, who was deep in the enemy's nest, fought wits and courage with his body to snatch the body, and anticipated the enemy's moves to collect rare treasures. In the end, under his wits and courage, Lu Shaoqing became the first playboy of the righteous path who was hated by everyone! The secrets of the world of cultivation gradually surfaced. Lu Shaoqing counted with his fingers, and the history had already changed!

(Source: Bilibili, Google translated)
